_note: Eight nodes per element. 'requires' lists node ids; 'requires_any' true means one of them is enough. A node either unlocks an ability slot ('unlock'), changes ability stats ('mods': mult or add), or gives a passive ('passive': hp_mult, speed_mult, chi_regen_mult, chi_max_add). The basic attack is always unlocked.

fire.name: Flame Breath
fire.desc: Unlock RMB: a burst of fire in a cone in front of you.

fire.name: Fireball
fire.desc: Unlock E: a slow, heavy fireball that explodes on impact.

fire.name: Jet Dash
fire.desc: Unlock Q: blast fire from your feet for a dash that can't be hit.

fire.name: Hotter Jabs
fire.desc: Fire Jabs (and the flame kick) deal 25% more damage.

fire.name: Fire Ring
fire.desc: Unlock F: spin a ring of fire that burns, throws back and stops incoming shots.

fire.name: Dragon Breath
fire.desc: Flame Breath reaches 2 m farther and burns 30% hotter.

fire.name: Lightning
fire.desc: Unlock R: gather energy, then strike with lightning wherever you aim.

water.name: Ice Daggers
water.desc: Unlock RMB: three fast ice daggers that slow what they hit.

water.name: Ice Prison
water.desc: Unlock E: an icy orb that freezes its target in place.

water.name: Healing Water
water.desc: Unlock Q: heal 30 HP over 4 seconds.

water.name: Ice Wall
water.desc: Unlock F: raise a wall of ice that blocks shots for 4 seconds.

water.name: Flowing Spirit
water.desc: 20% more HP and Healing Water heals 15 more.

water.name: Tidal Wave
water.desc: Unlock R: a huge wave that rolls along the ground through everything.

earth.name: Earth Column
earth.desc: Unlock RMB: a pillar of rock bursts up where you aim and launches anyone on it.

earth.name: Fissure
earth.desc: Unlock E: a line of stone spikes races along the ground.

earth.name: Rock Armor
earth.desc: Unlock Q: stomp, then cover yourself in rock: half damage for 5 s, a little slower.

earth.name: Stone Wall
earth.desc: Unlock F: raise a wall of stone that blocks shots for 6 seconds.

earth.name: Mountain Rise
earth.desc: Earth Column hits 30% harder and throws higher.

earth.name: Boulder Barrage
earth.desc: Unlock R: rip three huge boulders out of the ground and hurl them.

air.name: Air Cannon
air.desc: Unlock RMB: a fast ball of air that shoves its target away.

air.name: Air Blade

air.name: Air Scooter
air.desc: Unlock Q: ride a ball of air for 3 s, much faster with higher jumps.

air.name: Wide Blast
air.desc: Air Blast reaches 40% farther and pushes harder.

air.name: Air Shield

air.name: Tornado
air.desc: Unlock R: a spinning tornado that drags enemies in.
